title: Make coder upstream boundary checks fail on Git errors
description: JTBD: prevent a failed diff read from being reported as a passing upstream boundary. Scope: governance owner of .agents/skills/pbo-coder/SKILL.md, boundary commands around lines 69-76. QA reproduced the documented pipeline with a deliberately missing base ref: git emitted fatal unknown revision, but the pipeline printed BOUNDARY PASS and exited 0. Both checks use grep plus && echo FAIL || echo PASS, collapsing read errors into no-match. Required fix: resolve refs and capture git diff successfully before filtering; return nonzero for read errors and forbidden paths. Acceptance: valid allowed diff passes; forbidden path fails nonzero; missing base and Git failure fail nonzero without PASS. Evidence: .work/library-selector/bootstrap-qa.md. No product edits; governance only.
close_reason: Independent QA reran the exact extracted Python boundary code in isolated synthetic Git repositories: allowed product/build/docs/.gitignore plus newline path exit 0; forbidden .agents path exit 1; missing upstream/main exit 128; simulated Git failure exit 73. All failed cases emit no PASS. Skill validator passes. Evidence: .work/library-selector/pbo-sdy-retest.json; bootstrap-qa.md refreshed. No product edits.
